'''Hijado''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], halfway to [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of Hijado were called [[Hijadoan]]s. It was located in the [[Hijado system/Legends|Hijado system]] of the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]].
